trivial-sigma-branch.decision: Ship as observation: constant-true test/permissionless scripts are intentional; writable data remains limited to direct result disjuncts.

unauthenticated-code-execution.decision: Retain medium review priority: only the authored positive reports; no benign deployed site was observed, which is not a precision guarantee.
